context: Asuka and Mei discuss a church scene in the film.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: film discussion; vocabulary (少年/従来/向かっ/小泉/教会) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 少年が教会に行く場面、好きです。
lines.en: I love the scene where the boy goes to the church.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle moved delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古い教会へ、向かって歩きますね。
lines.en: He walks toward the old church.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 従来の自分を、捨てる場面ですよね。
lines.en: It's where he sheds his conventional self.
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、従来の迷いを、教会で手放します。
lines.en: Yes, he lets go of old doubts at the church.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 時代は、小泉政権の頃でしたね。
lines.en: It was set in the Koizumi-government era, right?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、小泉氏の時代の街並みです。
lines.en: Yes, the streetscape is from the Koizumi era.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 少年が前へ向かって、泣けました。
lines.en: The boy moving forward made me cry.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教会の光が、未来を照らしますね。
lines.en: The church's light illuminates the future.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
